gloss: to acquire, to learn, to wear

definitions.gloss: to acquire, to learn, to master
definitions.explanation: To gain knowledge or skills through learning and practice; to make something one's own.
To wear or put on clothing, accessories, or equipment.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}を{身|み}につけたい。
examples.english: I want to acquire Japanese language skills.

examples.japanese: {基本的|きほんてき}なマナーを{身|み}につける。
アクセサリーを{身|み}につけている。

notes:
COMPOUND: {身|み} (body) + につける (to attach to)

SENSE 1 (acquire/learn):
- {知識|ちしき}を{身|み}につける (acquire knowledge)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{身|み}につける (master a skill)
- {習慣|しゅうかん}を{身|み}につける (develop a habit)
- {力|ちから}を{身|み}につける (gain strength/ability)

SENSE 2 (wear):
- {服|ふく}を{身|み}につける (wear clothes)
- {時計|とけい}を{身|み}につける (wear a watch)
- {香水|こうすい}を{身|み}につける (wear perfume)

NUANCE: For sense 1, {身|み}につける implies that something becomes part of you through practice, not just superficial learning.
